title: Slabfishies Everywhere!
body:
# ...why is a **Slabfish** here?!?
now you'll be able to ask yourself just that, wherever you go! 

have you ever found **Them** to be too hard to find? have you ever felt that being able to see **Their** magnificent skins only if you capture them and breed them in specific biomes was too cruel of a fate? boy howdy, is this datapack is for you!

it adds **Slabfishies** to a bunch of biomes, both from vanilla and various abnormal mods (it wasn't tested whether or not this datapack works with only some/none of the abnormal mods installed, but i'd assume it's still be fine to use if you lack some). 

details about the new spawns:

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

**slabfish_extra**: each of the following biomes will be able to spawn 1-2 **slabfishy** with the weight of 5:

```
    "minecraft:wooded_badlands",
    "minecraft:bamboo_jungle",
    "minecraft:cherry_grove",
    "minecraft:flower_forest",
    
    "environmental:blossom_valleys",
    "environmental:blossom_woods",
    "environmental:old_growth_pine_barrens",

    "autumnity:maple_forest",
    "autumnity:pumpkin_fields",
    
    "atmospheric:flourishing_dunes",
    "atmospheric:kousa_jungle",
    "atmospheric:aspen_parkland",
    "atmospheric:laurel_forest"
```


**slabfish_rare**: each of the following biomes will be able to spawn a single **slabfishy** with the weight of 3:

```
    "minecraft:dark_forest",
    "minecraft:beach",
    "minecraft:desert",
    
    "environmental:pine_barrens",
    "environmental:pine_slopes",
    "environmental:dunes"
```


**slabfish_super_rare**: each of the following biomes will be able to spawn a single **slabfishy** with the weight of 1:

```
    "minecraft:plains",
    "minecraft:frozen_ocean",
    "endergetic:poise_forest"
```


**slabfish_mushroom**: the mushroom fields biome will be able to spawn 6-9 **slabfishy** with the weight of 20


the biomes were chosen based on my whim and whimsy, a.k.a. whether i thought the biome would've been pleasant to me if i was a slabfish or not. same goes for spawn chances.

</details>




## hope you enjoy!
